name: bundlebridge
description: Edit Java properties translations together with a searchable key tree and configurable formatting.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/properties.js && node --check src/applyDocument.js && node --check src/log.js && node --check src/bundleSettings.js && node --check src/settingsSchema.js && node --check media/editor.js

bundleBridge.unicodeEscape.description: Encode non-ASCII characters as Java \uXXXX escapes when saving.

bundleBridge.uppercaseHex.description: Use uppercase hexadecimal digits in Unicode escapes.

bundleBridge.delimiter.description: Separator between each key and value.

bundleBridge.spacesAroundDelimiter.description: Add a space on each side of the delimiter.

bundleBridge.alignment.description: Align delimiters across the file or within key groups.

bundleBridge.groupKeys.description: Sort keys into groups and insert blank lines between groups.

bundleBridge.groupSeparator.description: Separator used to build the key tree and formatting groups.

bundleBridge.groupDepth.description: Number of key segments in each formatting group.

bundleBridge.blankLinesBetweenGroups.description: Blank lines inserted between key groups when Group keys is enabled. All other blank lines are removed when saving or formatting.

bundleBridge.wrapColumn.description: Wrap values with Java continuation lines at this column. Zero disables wrapping.

bundleBridge.wrapAlign.description: Align continuation lines with the beginning of the value.

bundleBridge.wrapAfterNewline.description: Start a continuation line after escaped newline characters.

bundleBridge.valueNewline.description: Normalize newline characters inside translation values.

bundleBridge.lineEnding.description: Physical line endings used when saving files.

bundleBridge.keepEmptyValues.description: Keep keys with empty values. Disabling this removes empty entries on save.

bundleBridge.userLocaleOrder.description: Locale order for the translation panel when no workspace folder is open (User settings only). Not combined with Workspace locale order. Use "" for the base .properties file.

bundleBridge.workspaceLocaleOrder.description: Locale order for the translation panel in this workspace (Workspace settings only). Not combined with User locale order. Removing a locale from this list is respected; new locales are added only when you create locale files with BundleBridge. Use "" for the base .properties file.
